page.layout: One printed page with one column of text. Running head "VITA" centred at the top, page number at top left. Below the text, one footnote line at left, marked (i). Catchword at right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: scripsit Morino de Chronologia Muham-medanorum, eaque in primis quæ in Per-side à Doctoribus illius gentis de hoc ne-gotio didicerat; accepit etiam à Vallæo Morinus Linguæ Ægyptiacæ Alphabe-tum & alia nonnulla, quæ ad sermonem Ægyptiacum pertinebant, quorū cogni-tione ideò Morinus tenebatur, quòd in Bibliothecæ Oratorii Parisiensis foculis hunc[?] delitesceret exemplar quatuor E-vangeliorum, scriptum Linguâ Coptica, quò eam donarat Harlæus Sancius.

PRODEUNT interea Parisiis Morini exercitationes in utrumque Pentateu-chum Samaritanorum, ({i}) in quibus de gentis illius Religione, Moribus, illius li-teris, quas antiquos Hebræorum chara-cteres[?] esse fusius probat, & de illorum si-clis, quorum nonnullos profert, variè dif-ferit; statim ab initio operis in eo pec-cat quòd existimet, Samaritanorum Pen-tateuchum ab antiquis Ecclesiæ Patribus in usum suum Linguâ Græcâ donatum fuisse, cùm longè verisimilius sit ab ipsis

page.notes: Running head "VITA" is set in spaced capitals, as printed. The word "hunc" on the line "tunc delitesceret" is partly obscured; the first letter is uncertain. "cteres" at the start of the line after "chara-" has a damaged first letter; likely a ligature or a damaged "a" or "h", read as cteres[?]. The footnote mark (i) is in parentheses in the text. The right edge of the scan is damaged and shadowed, but no text is lost there. Printed spacing irregularities ("deChronologia", "Religione,Moribus") are left as printed.
